notes.title: More Accessibility settings
notes.content:
There have been requests for more options to disable some of the more intense visual effects in the game, sooo you can now toggle:
- Impact particles
- Screen flashes
- And you can adjust the Screen Shake intensity

...also there might be some big event happening when we reach 100 reviews, but I don't wanna spoil the surprise :P (Also holyyy whatttt we are almost at 100 reviews?!?! how?! TYSM!!! ^w^)

notes.title: ROSE just launched!
notes.content:
So this is it! The full version of [b]ROSE is finally live[/b]! Wohoo! 

[b]Ok, but what is actually in the game?[/b]
There are 5 playable regions, each has a custom final boss. Overall there are 60 maps, including bonus arenas and story levels. There are 6 weapons that can be upgraded and over 20 custom boosts. The game is now playable from start to finish and features a story that slowly unravels as you progress.

[b]Will there be any updates?[/b]
I will still be posting bug fixes and addressing major issues with the game, but I will no longer actively work on adding content or making big changes to the game.

[b]What about the demo?[/b]
Demo has been taken down, I talked about the reason why more, in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262170/view/4491871431840236063?l=english]this post[/url].

[b]What is the "Rose - Reflection" DLC?[/b]
It is a paid DLC that does not add anything to the game, but serves as optional donation (more in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262170/view/4491871431840236063?l=english]this post[/url])

[b]What if the game is a buggy mess?[/b]
If you encounter any issues, submit them to [url=https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4]our discord[/url], thank you!


Now I would just like to say HUGE THANK YOU to all of you who helped me finish this game by playtesting, wishlisting and watching my dev logs! It's been a long journey and I couldn't have done it alone! Now, go buy yourself a cookie, you deserve it!
- Zak

notes.title: ROSE DEMO
notes.content:
Hey, it has been way too long since I posted any updates to ROSE, so here we go with some big news!

[h3]There is a new Demo that has replaced the playtesting build.[/h3]
[b]What is in the demo:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 New regions (each region features unique enemies, movement mechanics and a region boss)
[*] Final set of weapons that will be in the full game (some weapons have been removed to reduce the scope, I will now focus on making the current set of weapons fun and balanced)
[*] New Sacrifices (several new sacrifices with progression have been added)
[*] More story maps / dialogues (after reaching certain milestones in the game, new story bits will unlock)
[*] Permanent upgrades have been replaced by per-run boosts
[*] New accessibility options (mainly an option to desaturate the environment and highlight enemies and important objects)
[/list]

Basically the [b]demo contains 3/4 of the final game[/b]. This way I want to test what works in the game and what doesn't before the game launches. The full version of Rose will be released in the upcoming months (definitely by the end of this year!).

[b]The demo is free and so will be the full game. [/b]

Please [b]share your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4]Discord server[/url][/b]! Your opinions will help shape the future of this game.

Thanks to everyone who participated in the playtest and shared their opinions! It has been a tremendous help in putting together this demo!
- Zak

notes.title: ROSE BETA
notes.content:
Hey there!

I would like to announce that a [b]free Beta version of ROSE is now available[/b] for download!

[h3]HOW TO PARTICIPATE IN THE BETA?[/h3]
To participate in the Beta, simply head to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262170/Rose/]Rose's Steam page[/url] and join the Beta in the [b]Join the Rose Playtest[/b] section.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262170/Rose/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43491749/ce7b49d2dda21f998042b59ddef0a3b8d87cdf86.png[/img][/url]

[h3]WHAT IS IN THE BETA VERSION?[/h3]
The Beta is completely free and at this moment features only a small portion of the game (limited selection of weapons, abilities, enemies and maps).

[h3]HOW TO SUBMIT FEEDBACK?[/h3]
If you participate in the Beta, please share your experience with the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4]Discord[/url] or in the comments of this post.

[h3]HOW LONG WILL THE BETA STAY ON?[/h3]
The Beta build will stay live from now on to an unspecified time. The Playtest version will be updated as I gather more feedback, but eventually the Beta will be removed as the game will move closer to the release date.

Huge thanks to all who decide to participate and share their feedback!
-Zak
